{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Fire Monkey|kanji=丙申|romaji=hinoe saru|onyomi=heishin|p=bǐngshēn|w=ping-shen|mi=pʰiŋ²¹ ʂən|y=bing2 san1|j=bing2 san1|ci=pɪŋ ʂɐn|mc=pæŋ ʂin|oc-bs=praŋ ʂin}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Fire Monkey''' (丙申, ''hinoe saru''; onyomi ''heishin'') is the 33rd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 33rd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Wood Goat|ja|乙未|1=Yin Wood Goat}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Fire Rooster|ja|丁酉|1=Yin Fire Rooster}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''丙'' is Yang Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''申'' (Monkey) is Yang Metal; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Fire Monkey (丙申)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): bǐngshēn
** Cantonese (Jyutping): bing3 san1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoe-saru
*** On'yomi: heishin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): byeongsin (병신)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Bính Thân

==Months of Yang Fire Monkey==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Sin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sin}} and {{ill|Hei|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hei}}), the month of {{ill|July|en|July|qid=Q121|lt=July|1=July}} is designated as the Heishin month ({{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}}). However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn|1=Liqiu}} until the day before {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew|1=Bailu (solar term)}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Fire Monkey==
The {{ill|selected day|ja|選日|1=Senjitsu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for Heishin is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
Heishin day is the 4th day of {{ill|Ten Ten Ichijō|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten Ten Ichijō|ja_comment=天一神|1=Tenitsu-shin|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
